# Syrin Notes

> Realtime markdown notes by URL. Create, share, and edit notes that sync across devices and work offline.

Syrin Notes lets anyone create a markdown note at a memorable URL (e.g. /my-note), edit it with autosave, and sync it in realtime across devices. Notes can be optionally encrypted with a passphrase and shared via revocable share links.

Made by Syrin, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Contact: syringa@syrin.online

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create a new note or open an existing one by URL.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Optional

- [Share link](/s/): Read-only shared view of a note (token-based, not crawlable).
